items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I don't want to say because I don't know, but I think that that guy--what's his name--Sondheim--writes all the stuff out.

ctx.x: That I thought was incredible, the orchestration he did. I think he was given free range and just used his imagination, which is generally the case.
I don't want to say because I don't know, but I think that that guy--what's his name--Sondheim--writes all the stuff out.
